worker.label: Ma'aikata
worker.tagline: Nemo aiki, karɓi kuɗi, ci gaba

hero.sub: Gano ingantattun ayyuka kusa da kai, tabbatar da aikinka da lamba, kuma karɓi kuɗinka kai tsaye zuwa bankinka — yayin da kowane aiki ke gina Tally Score ɗinka wanda zai buɗe bashi.

employer.label: Masu Ɗaukar Aiki
employer.tagline: Ɗauki wanda aka tabbatar, biya bayan tabbaci

hero.emphasis: Biya kawai don aikin da aka tabbatar.
hero.sub: Sanya aiki cikin mintuna kaɗan, gayyaci mutane masu tarihi na gaskiya, kuma sanya kuɗi cikin ajiya (escrow). Kuɗi na fita ne kawai lokacin da aka tabbatar da halarta — don haka ba za ka taɓa biya wa wanda bai zo ba.
hero.secondaryCta: Duba yadda ɗaukar aiki ke gudana

trader.label: 'Yan Kasuwa
trader.tagline: Gudanar da kasuwancinka ka bunƙasa shi

hero.emphasis: Mai da kowace sayarwa zuwa bashi.
hero.sub: Rubuta sayarwarka don gina tarihin da za a iya tabbatarwa, wanda ke buɗe rancen kaya a yau — kuma ka shirya don cikakkun kayan aikin kasuwanci: POS, kaya, biyan kuɗi da nazari, suna zuwa nan ba da jimawa ba.

hero.trustLine: Tsari guda ɗaya da ya haɗa tattalin arzikin da ba na yau da kullun ba na Najeriya — ma'aikata, masu ɗaukar aiki, da 'yan kasuwa.

marquee.title: An gina shi a kan ingantattun kayayyakin more rayuwa masu lasisi

ecosystem.title: Nau'i uku na mutane. Shaidar tattalin arziki guda ɗaya da aka raba.
ecosystem.subtitle: Ma'aikata, masu ɗaukar aiki, da 'yan kasuwa — kowanne yana da samfurin da aka gina masa, waɗanda shaida guda, escrow, da Tally Score ke haɗawa.

features.title: Hanyoyin da ke sa komai aiki

language.sub: Yi aiki, ɗauki ma'aikata, kuma yi kasuwanci a harshen da ya fi maka sauƙi. An tsara Tally bisa yadda 'yan Najeriya ke magana da gaske — a app, a USSD, da WhatsApp.

how.title: Hanya bayyananniya — ga duk wanda kake

roadmap.title: Inda Tally ke nufi na gaba

testimonials.title: Aiki na gaskiya. Biya na gaskiya. Amana ta gaskiya.
testimonials.subtitle: Daga kowane ɓangare na dandamalin.
testimonials.lovedBy: Ma'aikata, masu ɗaukar aiki da 'yan kasuwa suna son sa

faq.title: Tambayoyi, an amsa su
faq.subtitle: Zaɓi wanda kake domin amsoshin da suka shafe ka.

finalCta.title: Duk wanda kake, fara ƙidaya aikinka yau
finalCta.body: Haɗu da ma'aikata, masu ɗaukar aiki, da 'yan kasuwa da ke gina shaidar tattalin arziki da za a iya tabbatarwa — kuma suna karɓar kuɗi da sauri saboda haka.
finalCta.note: Babu wayar hannu? Buga *347*82# ko aiko mana saƙo a WhatsApp.
